test_item_verbatim: When the rear images are displayed on TLM_Display.GUI the setted brightness must be over 50%, in order to visualize better the images (refers to FMVSS 111 and according to ECE-REG46 regulations).

tcs.tc_title: displayed brightness is above 50 %, display the image and measure the brightness
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted)
2. Read the brightness of the displayed rear image on the HU display and check its level
tcs.expected_result:
1. STATUS_CCAN4.ReverseGearSts = 1 (Inserted) is sent and the rear image is displayed
2. The brightness of the displayed rear image is over 50 %
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
When the rear images are displayed on TLM_Display.GUI the setted brightness must be over 50%, in order to visualize better the images (refers to FMVSS 111 and according to ECE-REG46 regulations).

(displayed brightness is above 50 %, display the image and measure the brightness)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V33-234` 之「rear 影像顯示於 `TLM_Display.GUI` 時，亮度須超過 50 %（FMVSS 111 與 ECE-REG46）」。**量測手段來源未載，不造工具**（§8.4.1）—— procedure 只寫 `Read the brightness … and check its level`，由人工以亮度治具量測；本列已列入 `bench_verify.md`。來源之 `setted` 為 SYS2 之拼寫，依逐字原則不更正。
